polarization_route: one PYATB run per geometry, three directions
symmetry_note: All v2 structure symmetry operations, atom mapping, and response bases use symprec=1e-3. ABACUS uses symmetry=1 only for the reference and symmetry=0 for every finite-strain geometry; all INPUT files still serialize symmetry_prec=0.001.

symmetry_response_audit.interpretation: The direct piezoelectric and elastic tensors are accepted after exact P6_3mc projection; raw residuals remain persisted. The internal-strain residual is a separate BEC-Lambda reconstruction diagnostic, not an input to direct e or d.

excluded_audit: A prior batch with ABACUS symmetry enabled on finite-strain cells is excluded: the backend projected genuine strains towards the reference symmetry. The present strict-protocol batch supersedes it.

symmetry_audit.note: All v2 symmetry identification, atom mapping and response-basis stages use the fixed symprec=1e-3 policy.
